gold: Trifascicular heart block (Bifascicular block with first-degree AV block progressing to complete heart block)

selector.rationale: Patient's ECG and 24-hour ECG monitoring show evidence of first-degree, second-degree, and third-degree AV block, which is a direct indicator of heart block.

rejected.label: Pulmonary hypertension
rejected.why: Although present, it does not directly explain the syncope and exercise intolerance as well as heart block does.

rejected.label: Cardiac Amyloidosis
rejected.why: There is not enough evidence in the vignette to support this diagnosis, and other options better explain the patient's symptoms.
